title: Tesla launches Tesla Energy line of batteries for homes, businesses and utilities
主要内容: Tesla launched its Tesla Energy brand, offering home, business, and utility batteries. The Powerwall, a 7-10 kWh lithium-ion battery, is priced at $3,000-$3,500 for installers and is expected to be delivered in three to four months. Tesla plans to build the battery packs at its $5 billion Gigafactory near Reno, Nevada, which could produce up to 500,000 lithium-ion batteries by 2020. Musk estimated that transitioning global transportation, electricity generation, and heating to renewable energy would require around 2 billion Powerpack batteries, comparable to the number of vehicles on the road globally. The launch is expected to disrupt the electricity market, similar to the impact of mobile phones in remote areas. Tesla's batteries and solar power were used to power the press conference, without grid electricity.
